scope.description: One real cluster history with later leadership and successful Apply completed before old verification invocation. Held old-term replies may be delivered after registration; other old-leader traffic is finitely delayed or disconnected. Public verification success is the primary endpoint; stale FSM contents are optional additional observations.
assumptions: Fixed voter membership; all successful reply producers are legitimate voters.
Actual bootstrap/elections/Apply generate the prefix; no direct term/role/commit mutation.
The higher-term leader Apply.Error completion must causally precede old VerifyLeader call.
Lease and negative-response workers remain running. Controlled delays and partitions are non-Byzantine and finite; any suppressed path is explicitly described.
excluded: Liveness claim from pending verification or cutoff.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Transport wrapper withholds first real reply from each old peer sender loop and parks subsequent old calls; no response fields are changed.
Disable optional pipeline support using supported error fallback.
Use public Disconnect and ReloadConfig to establish a bounded legal network/scheduling history.
Observe future.Error, public State/CurrentTerm, persisted configuration and locked MockFSM command presence. No target protocol state is assigned.

plan_uncertainties: This checks the VerifyLeader authority contract; it does not establish divergent committed logs or overall consensus failure.
Diagnostic old FSM omission of the newer completed command is an observed stale-data consequence at this endpoint, not a universal read-protocol theorem.
The wrapper delays transport completion after actual reply production; it is not a real TCP packet-loss implementation.
Current-leader control shares the cluster transition but is a separate future; histories and identities are not merged.
grounding_unresolved: Need actual later election and committed command before the old verification invocation in one execution.
Must establish reply production before the later election, hold all other old-leader delivery paths, and observe same-future completion.
Need validate admissible timeout settings and finite delays leave lease protection active through the measured endpoint.
Peer timeout reload changes scheduling configuration, not voter membership. Equal-timeout deployments are outside this execution.
Any missed setup transition or observation deadline leaves no matched result rather than providing a passing safety observation.
Exact callback that drains old verification (ordinary append versus heartbeat) is not isolated.
The observed command-presence field is diagnostic; the primary oracle checks successful authority verification after an independently established prior transition.
